scope: Qwen3.8-27B Wave 5 stock-EXL3 and full-checkpoint candidates

split_identity_contract.invariant: one combined R29 manifest file/content identity; split labels are distinguished only by their exact selector and selection/projection SHA256

primary.inventory: 5120 contexts, 10 shards, 842 source clusters, 941 source documents with hashes, exact stored token IDs
primary.grouping: source-cluster/document identities from the corpus manifest are the bootstrap and split units
primary.validation: R29 hash-selected v5 shard0 contexts with retained BF16 replay
primary.untouched_confirmation: R29 hash-selected source-cluster-disjoint v5 contexts from shards1-9, opened once through the capability/canonical-state gate
primary.caveat: v5 has historical use; untouched means not opened during Wave 5 method development, not never previously evaluated

external_stress.limitations: analysis and qualification are not source-disjoint; replay absolute floor is approximately 6.5e-4; never use for selection or primary promotion

vocabulary.axis: complete tokenizer/model output vocabulary in canonical token-id order

reference_semantics.projection: both body operands use the one shared BF16 LM head, so primary KLD/EAR are body-only
reference_semantics.capture_point: post-final-norm hidden states, rows 0..2046 of each 2048-token context
reference_semantics.determinism_scope: pinned eager TP1, max_num_seqs=1, one full 2048-token chunk, BF16 KV; not CUDA-graph or multi-sequence determinism
reference_semantics.bf16_decode: uint16 payload shifted into float32 high 16 bits; never IEEE-FP16 reinterpretation
reference_semantics.reference_capture_policy: never recapture retained v5 shard0 BF16 reference; shards1-9 references were deleted and may be captured exactly once when the once-open confirmatory test requires them, then hash and retain them for all candidate/control replay
reference_semantics.existing_reports: context only; they never substitute for fresh candidate/control captures under this contract
reference_semantics.served_head_axis: candidate-own-head full-vocabulary replay is a separately labeled head-inclusive promotion axis; a body-only win never satisfies it

served_head_contract.identity: the exact candidate head tensor file SHA256, tensor dtype, tensor shape, candidate checkpoint SHA256, capture hashes, report SHA256, and row payload SHA256 are frozen together
served_head_contract.promotion_policy: candidate-own-head replay must independently pass the same absolute and paired-noninferiority gates as body-only shared-head replay
served_head_contract.substitution: body-only and served-head reports are both mandatory and may never substitute for or relabel each other

kld.name: forward KLD
kld.p: retained BF16 reference after shared BF16 LM head
kld.q: candidate after the same shared BF16 LM head
kld.primary_mean: token mean over rows 0..2046; context macro mean is also reported and identical because every context has exactly 2047 scored positions
kld.computation: method-of-record two-pass vocabulary walk in chunks of 24832, float32 inside a chunk and float64 accumulated across chunks
kld.ci: 95% percentile interval from the frozen source-cluster bootstrap
kld.proxy_prohibition: MSE, OC-HWE, Fisher-HWE, block-output error, hidden-state distance, local softmax, truncated-vocabulary KL, and local tensor metrics are never KLD

p99_kld.definition: linear empirical 0.99 quantile of per-position forward KLD

cvar1_kld.definition: upper-tail expected shortfall over exactly 1% of scored-position mass, with fractional boundary weight

top1_agreement.definition: mean indicator that full-vocabulary argmax(q) equals argmax(p)
top1_agreement.tie_rule: lowest canonical token id, matching numpy argmax

required_breakdowns: mean JSD bits, exact maximum, p50/p95/p99/p999, fixed 560-bin tail histogram
worst 20 contexts by mean forward KLD
five strata: code, encyclopedic, literary, multilingual, scientific

statistical_contract.sampling_unit: complete source-cluster document/conversation and its contexts
non_independent_units: tensors/blocks produced by one source document

bootstrap.algorithm: for each replicate sample source clusters with replacement, retain every position of every context belonging to each selected cluster, then recompute mean, global pooled per-position p99, global pooled per-position CVaR1%, EAR, and top1; apply identical draws to candidate and control
bootstrap.mean_estimand: global token mean KLD, identical to context-macro mean because every context has 2047 rows
bootstrap.tail_interval_estimand: global pooled per-position p99/CVaR1%; per-shard or per-context quantiles are never averaged
bootstrap.ties: strict candidate wins, strict control wins, and exact ties counted separately

local_screening_macro.block: compute candidate_metric/stock_metric within each identical block; zero-over-zero is 1 and positive-over-zero is +infinity
local_screening_macro.tensor: arithmetic mean of preregistered block ratios, exactly one value per tensor; also report median and all blocks
local_screening_macro.role_depth_cell: arithmetic mean over tensors in that role/depth cell, exactly one value per tensor
local_screening_macro.role_macro: arithmetic mean over represented preregistered depths, exactly one value per depth
local_screening_macro.depth_macro: arithmetic mean over represented preregistered roles, exactly one value per role
local_screening_macro.global_macro: arithmetic mean over role macros, exactly one value per role
local_screening_macro.raw_error_pooling: forbidden because tensor scale and block count would dominate
local_screening_macro.promotion_power: none; local metrics only shortlist candidates

search_and_multiplicity.unit_of_budget: actual legal stock-EXL3 encoder/Viterbi evaluation of a complete action
search_and_multiplicity.equal_budget_rule: each candidate and both controls receive identical per-unit evaluation counts and identical seed lists; an arm that cannot consume the budget forfeits unused evaluations rather than donating them
search_and_multiplicity.common_random_numbers: same calibration documents, activation rows, blocks, tensor order, initialization seeds, and Viterbi/search seeds for every arm
search_and_multiplicity.calibration: fresh source-disjoint EXL3 standard calibration plus UltraChat-train dialogue documents may fit curvature, scales, targets, paths, transforms, and callbacks; they may not select a reported arm
search_and_multiplicity.validation: v5 shard 0 is the only split permitted for model/action/K/alpha/seed/shrinkage/stopping/interaction/byte-frontier selection
search_and_multiplicity.untouched_test: the R29 frozen source-cluster-disjoint v5 shards1-9 allocation is opened once only after one complete candidate hash is frozen; no tuning, reseeding, arm substitution, threshold change, or second opening

multiple_searches.within_registered_arm: all tried settings count against that arm's fixed validation budget
multiple_searches.across_arms: report every registered arm and validation attempt; final test evaluates the single frozen winner plus F0 and F0-fresh controls
multiple_searches.confirmatory_claim: the one frozen test contrast is primary; all other test inspection is exploratory and cannot promote
multiple_searches.failed_run: replace only for preregistered infrastructure failure documented before any metric is read, with the same seed and arm

F0-fresh.definition: fresh stock-current actual-EXL3 conversion from the frozen BF16 source with the shipped K5/K6 recipe and R30 stock action, equal search/seed budget, actual serialization and decode
F0-fresh.purpose: controls converter freshness and stock stochasticity

practical_equivalence_F0_fresh_minus_F0.failure: do not use F0-fresh as the promotion baseline; investigate converter/control mismatch without reopening test

absolute_fidelity_constraints.note: thresholds frozen before Wave5 results; body-only replay systematics are disclosed and never subtracted as an additive floor

required: untouched-test open-state hash and hash-chained access event
separate full-vocabulary candidate-own-head replay passing the same absolute and paired-noninferiority gates
promotion.lower_byte_rule: candidate exact serialized bytes must be at least max(1048576 bytes, 0.01% of F0-fresh exact serialized bytes) lower
promotion.equal_byte_rule: if exact bytes are equal, mean_kld candidate-minus-F0-fresh CI95 high must be <0, EAR CI95 low must be >0, and every tail/top1 noninferiority bound must pass

slq_primal.objective: minimize the exact integer sum of one selected complete R30 action per legal topology/fused unit
enforced_invariants: R30 action-registry SHA256 equals the frozen candidate/open state
every registered unit occurs exactly once in the assignment
every selected action exists under that unit and carries wave5/exl3-action/1
selected action exact bytes sum to the frozen checkpoint exact bytes
fidelity, route, runtime, startup, graph, and context gates pass
slq_primal.bytes: actual payload plus headers, alignment, signs, scales, codebook IDs, path/selector metadata, sidecars, and every candidate-only decode artifact
slq_primal.solution_verification: fresh sequential full-checkpoint rebuild and once-open untouched-test capture/replay; additive proxy constraints cannot promote

slq_dual_frontier.objective: on the complete declared screened action registry, at each reachable measured exact-byte budget lexicographically minimize mean KLD, p99, CVaR1%, negative EAR, negative top1, runtime seconds, then startup seconds

solver_semantics.legal_set: the complete declared screened R30 unit/action menu; exactly one complete legal action per unit
solver_semantics.bytes: exact integer sum of complete-action exact_serialized_bytes
solver_semantics.constraints: all frozen fidelity, byte, route, runtime, startup, graph, context, and no-fallback constraints
solver_semantics.selection_data: validation only; untouched-test metrics are forbidden
solver_semantics.ties: equal lexicographic metric tuples form an equivalence class sorted by assignment SHA256; the smallest SHA256 is canonical
solver_semantics.candidate: selected assignment SHA256 and complete checkpoint SHA256 are frozen before test opening
solver_semantics.completeness: every registered reachable measured exact-byte budget from the declared screened menu is present; no global optimum outside that menu is claimed

slq_dual_frontier.validation: unique increasing exact budgets, legal canonical assignment at every point, candidate point/checkpoint present, validation measurement hashes, all-cheaper-point dominance, and exact tie canonicalization
slq_dual_frontier.oracle: the gate self-test enumerates a two-unit screened menu and requires solver output to equal the independent Cartesian-product oracle on that targeted menu
slq_dual_frontier.interactions: targeted fused/high-sensitivity interactions are complete remeasured actions; correction is never appended after allocation

steps: verify BF16 source tensor, F0/F0-fresh checkpoint, R29 split manifest, R30 action, tensor name, and source offset hashes
serialize and decode the complete candidate tensor through the exact R30 action and assert source-basis shape/dtype
copy F0-fresh to a new artifact; replace exactly the registered serialized tensor buffers and required metadata; never mutate controls
hash the candidate manifest and prove every non-target file/buffer equals F0-fresh
load declared exact route with fallback counters armed; capture once on validation or the once-open test
replay against retained BF16 reference through shared BF16 LM head over all 248320 tokens
emit contract metrics and paired document/context bootstrap against both controls with all artifact hashes
freeze complete per-unit R30 action registry and exact-byte manifest after validation
perform fresh sequential conversion into a new artifact and verify every buffer, sidecar, alignment byte, route ID, and exact total
freeze complete checkpoint hash before test access
open test once with fidelity_gate.py open-test and use identical request order/common randomness for candidate and controls
reuse retained shard0 BF16 reference; if confirmatory shards1-9 are selected, capture their missing BF16 references once only, hash and retain them
capture candidate, F0, and F0-fresh once on identical contexts; existing reports are not substitutes
replay through same BF16 head and emit full-vocabulary metrics, paired intervals, strata, worst contexts, and separately labeled candidate-own-head attribution
qualify codec-exact and unchanged production profiles; reject fallback or unregistered route

serialized_byte_breakdown.invariant: the four fields sum exactly to exact_serialized_bytes and equal a qwen38-wave5-checkpoint-byte-manifest/1 whose canonically ordered entries are re-hashed and stat-sized from the actual files; directories, sparse holes, resident memory, and filesystem block allocation are not substituted for serialized file bytes

deployment_report_schema.control_byte_invariant: candidate, F0-fresh, and shipped F0 each provide qwen38-wave5-checkpoint-byte-manifest/1, checkpoint identity, exact_serialized_bytes, and the same four-component nonnegative integer breakdown summing exactly to stat-sized, SHA256-verified files; F0-fresh also binds the frozen stock action SHA256

served_head_evidence.interpretation: both capture-bound full-vocabulary reports are independently evaluated; body-only evidence cannot satisfy the served-head gate

codec_exact.baseline: F0-fresh under identical codec-exact route/runtime stack

production.baseline: F0 shipped under identical unchanged throughput runtime stack

required_measurements_per_profile: schema qwen38-wave5-runtime-profile/2 and exact route/action/checkpoint/head/open-state identities
content-digested image, vLLM/build revision, GPU UUID/name, driver, attention backend, KV dtype, MTP count, graph mode, and profile
exact effective environment object plus an identical hash-bound environment receipt
separate hash-bound startup receipt, runtime receipt, and raw harness evidence
graph capture success, seconds, modes, and captured shapes
actual decode graph parity on frozen greedy prompts with logprobs, repeated within mode, compared with same-stack BF16 control; prefill capture is not decode-graph evidence
prefill tok/s at M approximately 2048 and 6144
decode tok/s and MTP acceptance for every registered concurrency/prompt row
fallback count and fallback reason list

decode_graph_probe.harness: actual autoregressive decode, 32 frozen prompts x 32 greedy tokens, fixed seed, logprobs, ignore_eos
decode_graph_probe.repeat: two independent collections per eager/graph mode; within-mode determinism reported
decode_graph_probe.gate: candidate graph drift must lie within the preregistered BF16 control envelope; a prefill hidden capture cannot satisfy this field

report_compatibility.R30_stock: candidate_id=F0-fresh plus action_registry_sha256 and exact R30 route IDs populate the same fields
report_compatibility.later_full_checkpoint: any registered complete-action assignment populates the same immutable schema; no threshold, metric, or route inference amendment
report_compatibility.unknown_extension: an unregistered metric may be exploratory but cannot replace a required field
